note: The Evidence menu, as the estate means it. Written 9 October 2026 after a comparison of all eight menus (122 entries, 9 to 25 per archive, five labels common to all). The 15 September menu canon fixed the ORDER OF THE GROUPS and one label per shared route; it never said what Evidence contains, so each archive filled it with whatever it had built. This file says. A menu label is estate-wide so a reader learns it once; a page TITLE may stay the archive's own voice.

core.label: Method
core.asks: What would make you believe or not believe this?

core.label: Sources
core.asks: What does this stand on, and where do I check?

core.label: What Has Been Read
core.asks: What was looked at, and what did it not turn up?

core.label: Open Questions
core.asks: What is not known, and what would settle it?

core.label: Errands
core.asks: What has been asked of other people, or needs someone standing in a place?

core.label: The work list
core.asks: What is being done, by whom, since when?

core.label: Corrections
core.asks: What did this archive get wrong?

folds.note: Pages that do the same job as a core page under another name. Until each is folded they stay reachable; the checker names them so the fold is visible work, not a surprise. Each fold keeps its old route working. Read on 9 October 2026 and deliberately NOT folds: Lerena's Hypotheses (fourteen argued propositions with tables and an image analysis, and the build checks its contents list against its sections) and Roadmap (an argued ranking of routes with results). A fold is for a list that does a core page's job; an argued dossier stays a local page under Investigations.

overflow.label: Investigations
overflow.note: Where an archive's OWN pages go once they leave Evidence: catalogues of where the records are, analyses, and the exhibits that are not Documents or Gallery. Optional, local, in the archive's own voice. Evidence stays the same eight everywhere; this group is allowed to differ.
